title: Kirkland parchment, 2 pack
text: Kirkland parchment, 2 pack. I USED to be able to buy this at costco, but haven't found it for years there... I was thrilled to be able to get these on Amazon!  It's 2 really big rolls - a lot bigger than the tiny ones you can get at my local area stores. One roll lasts me many months, but I don't use it daily.  It's an awesome way to bake fish.. line cups and such when baking making cleanup easier and a no fat option to non stick cooking.  If you wet the parchment paper and crunch it, you can mold it into any pan or baking dish and trim excess with ease.  I am thrilled to find these huge rolls in a 2 pack and delivered right to my door.
